data.investment_objective: To  generate  capital  appreciation  by  investing  in  a  concentrated  portfolio  of equity  and  equity  related  securities  of  up  to  30  companies  across  market capitalization i.e. focus on multicap. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
• Equity & Equity related securities = 65% - 100%
• Debt & Money market instruments = 0% - 35 %
data.exit_load: 1 % of applicable Net Asset Value If the amount sought to be redeemed or switch out within 1 Year from allotment. Nil If the amount sought to be redeemed or switched out more than 1 Year.
